name: Prism-TS-TW
blurb: A glowing 3D prism that rotates on its own or responds to cursor position.
description: WebGL shader rendering a volumetric raymarched pyramid/prism with three animation modes: continuous rotation, cursor-tracking hover, or combined 3D orbit. Supports glow, bloom, hue shifting, and noise.
use_when: Hero sections, product showcases, or high-impact backgrounds where a technical, luminous 3D effect elevates the visual presence.
avoid_when: WebGL-unsupported devices, touch-only surfaces (hover mode needs pointer), performance-critical mobile — raymarching 100 steps is expensive.
a11y: Passive visual background; no keyboard interaction or focus states. Does not respect prefers-reduced-motion.
